TOSS-UP 8) LIFE SCIENCE Multiple Choice Which structure closes over the trachea [TRAY-kee-uh]
during swallowing to keep food out of the airway?
W) Epiglottis [ep-uh-GLOT-is]
X) Alveolus [al-VEE-uh-lus]
Y) Diaphragm [DY-uh-fram]
Z) Bronchus [BRONG-kus]
ANSWER: W) EPIGLOTTIS


BONUS
8) CHEMISTRY Short Answer Name the process represented by 6CO2 + 6H2O → C6H12O6 + 6O2, in which plants convert light energy into chemical energy.
ANSWER: PHOTOSYNTHESIS


TOSS-UP 9) GENERAL SCIENCE Short Answer Name the scientist whose three laws of motion form the foundation of classical mechanics.
ANSWER: ISAAC NEWTON
